description: 1. Agent announces use of the finishing-a-development-branch skill. 2. Agent runs `pytest` in the worktree (`/workspace/transaction-validator-worktree`) and confirms all tests pass before doing anything else. 3. Agent determines the base branch is `main` (via `git merge-base` or inspection). 4. Agent presents EXACTLY 4 structured options (Merge locally / Push+PR / Keep as-is / Discard) and waits for user input — it must NOT directly merge without presenting options. 5. User selects Option 1 (Merge locally). 6. Agent runs: `git checkout main` in the main repo, `git pull` (no-op locally), `git merge feature/transaction-validator`. 7. Agent re-runs `pytest` on the merged main branch and confirms tests still pass. 8. Agent runs `git branch -d feature/transaction-validator`. 9. Agent detects the worktree via `git worktree list` and runs `git worktree remove /workspace/transaction-validator-worktree`. 10. Final state: `main` branch contains the validator commits, feature branch is deleted, worktree directory is gone from `git worktree list` and from the filesystem. Critical proprietary traps: (a) must present 4 options before acting; (b) must verify tests BOTH before and after merge; (c) must clean up worktree for Option 1 (not optional); (d) must use `git branch -d` (not -D) since branch is fully merged.
